name: Sylvia
source:
She is the daughter of the three times former  head of the Over Heaven society, and the wife of two times former head, MingFung.
She is the real authority of the Over Heaven society and once assassinated Mary.
With the death of Yeung Kwun of the Red Flower society and the expulsion of the HH brothers Zhang Lei from the leadership of the Web, she plans to gain control of the Kowloon area.
She plans to assassinate Zhang Lei using " spiders".
translation:
She is the daughter of the three times former  head of the Over Heaven society, and the wife of two times former head, MingFung.
She is the real authority of the Over Heaven society and once assassinated Mary.
With the death of Yeung Kwun of the Red Flower society and the expulsion of the HH brothers Zhang Lei from the leadership of the Web, she plans to gain control of the Kowloon area.
She plans to assassinate Zhang Lei using " spiders".
